## Workload

Hannah Lowe recorded a workload of 522 reads completed over 256 hours. This represents 2.0 reads per hour. The figures provide a clear summary of activity for the period and support review of the current working pattern. The workload information was considered by Priya Anand as part of the review.

## Quality

A sample of 50 reads was checked. Agreement between the grader and reviewer was 68.0 per cent. This result was considered alongside the workload information to provide an overall view of performance. Hannah Lowe and Priya Anand agreed to keep the current session pattern. The review records the checked sample and the level of agreement for the period.
